candidates.change_summary: Replace nonReentrant_ modifier to omit setting locked_ = true so reentrancy guard does not prevent reentrancy (only checks and resets), changing observable behavior of Put when reentered.
Replace assignment to acc.unlockTime so that it always sets unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp), allowing future earlier unlocking behavior to be observed after Put.
Replace acc.balance update to not increase the stored balance (assign msg.value instead of adding), changing the post-Put balance observable externally.
Replace call to LogFile.AddMessage with no call (deleted), removing the log side-effect but leaving state changes to acc, which can affect externally observed history behavior tied to Put.
Replace acc.unlockTime assignment to always set to block.timestamp (ignoring _unlockTime), which changes when funds become collectible after Put.
